text:
Get ready for the fastest, cleanest version yet! Framework 5.0 is here, and it's packed with upgrades that will make your development experience sing!

We've bid farewell to Node 16 to unlock modern runtime power and speed. Our brand-new router is a total game-changer, running an incredible 2.3x faster than before. Your apps will feel snappier than ever, and your users will love it!

We know upgrades can feel like a big step, so we've made the journey smooth. This release includes 7 breaking changes, but don't worry: we've included a codemod that handles the heavy lifting for you. Just run it, review the changes, and you're ready to go!

Whether you're building your next big product or refreshing an existing project, 5.0 is the release you've been waiting for. Upgrade today and experience the future of web development!
